input: Customers has one row per customer_id. Payments has one row per payment_id and customer_id; amount is additive at payment grain. Relationship: one customer to many payments. Join on customer_id, group by Customers.region, sum Payments.amount. No filters or deduplication. Assess only supplied facts.

measures.name: amount
measures.basis: Each payment row remains represented once in the supplied many-to-one join from Payments to Customers.

sequence: Join Payments to Customers on customer_id.
